description: A branching bronze guard and beveled leaf blade frame an inset emerald channel.
A swept crescent blade, hooked star guard and blue inlay catch the light.
Forged phoenix wings cradle a faceted ember above a wrapped ashwood shaft.
Four swept tide flanges surround a pale aquamarine core and bronze wave collars.
A scalloped bronze ward carries a raised branching oak and an emerald heart.
A bound grimoire wears raised crescent metalwork, star clasps and a sapphire seal.
